description:
As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you will build and maintain the applications that power Citi's Corporate Tax technology platform, working across the entire development lifecycle from user interface to database. You will develop features using React, JSF, Java, and Spring Boot while deploying services to a modern container-based infrastructure. This role puts you at the center of a team delivering tax applications that support critical financial reporting functions.
  
 Responsibilities 
  
 Build and maintain web interfaces using React and JSF alongside backend services built with Java and Spring Boot.
 Write and optimize Oracle SQL and PL/SQL queries, stored procedures, and tables to support tax processing and reporting.
 Package application services into containers and deploy them to Kubernetes and OpenShift environments.
 Develop automation scripts using Python, Shell, and SQL to support data validation and batch processing tasks.
 Build and maintain automated unit, integration, and regression test suites using JUnit, Mockito, and Selenium or Cypress.
 Participate in peer code reviews and resolve defects identified during testing cycles and release support.
 Collaborate with the team during agile sprint ceremonies to plan and deliver feature work.
  
 Required Qualifications & Skills 
  
 5 to 8 years of experience in full stack software development.
 Hands-on experience with React and Java-based frameworks such as Spring and Spring Boot.
 Proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL for relational database development.
 Experience deploying containerized applications using Kubernetes or OpenShift.
 A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  
 Beneficial Skills & Qualifications 
 Familiarity with modern data lake and query technologies such as Apache Iceberg, AWS S3, Snowflake, or Starburst and Trino.
 Experience using automation test runners to improve release consistency and code quality.
 Prior exposure to corporate tax, financial accounting data, or enterprise ledger structures is advantageous.
  
 What We Offer 
  
 You will build software within a team that supports one of Citi's most visible regulatory functions, giving you broad exposure across the full technology stack.
  
 Work in a hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely each week.
 Develop expertise across frontend, backend, and cloud deployment technologies.
 Take part in structured learning and development programs tailored to engineering careers.
 Access wellbeing and work-life balance support as part of your overall employee experience.
  
 Join Citi to build full stack solutions that power global tax technology.
